lastCompletedStory.title: Make sidecar process discovery in cam stop name-agnostic

nextStoryContext: `cam stop`'s fallback scoped `ps`-based sidecar discovery (src/commands/stop.ts) is now fully name-agnostic. The new exported `isSidecarArgv(argv: string[])` predicate matches on argv SHAPE alone (last element is the literal `'sidecar'` token, total length 2 or 3), never on a literal binary name: this covers both the compiled self-spawn shape `[execPath, 'sidecar']` (2 elements) and the interpreted shape `[runtime, script, 'sidecar']` (3 elements) that `buildSidecarSpawnArgv`/`buildSelfSpawnArgv(execPath, argv1, 'sidecar')` (US-002/US-003) actually produce. `matchesSidecarForProject` now composes `isSidecarArgv(record.argv)` with the UNCHANGED strict `record.cwd === projectCwd` scoping (still exact equality, no prefix/substring widening -- name-agnosticism only changed process recognition, not project scoping). `defaultListProcesses`'s `ps -eo pid,args` quick filter (the cheap pre-lsof screen) now reuses the same `isSidecarArgv` predicate instead of a `cmdBase !== 'cam'` literal, and no longer normalizes `argv[0]` to a bare basename before building the `ProcessRecord` -- raw argv (whatever path/runtime it actually is) is stored and matched against directly. This closes the GOTCHA flagged at the end of the US-002 patterns.md bullet (dev/interpreted-mode children advertise `<bun> <script> sidecar>` in `ps`, not a literal `cam sidecar`, and would have been invisible to the old name-literal filter). GOTCHA for whichever story next touches sidecar/self-spawn `ps`-discovery: `isSidecarArgv`'s length-2-or-3 shape assumption is specific to the CURRENT `buildSidecarSpawnArgv` call convention (exactly one subcommand word, no extra args ever appended after `'sidecar'`); if a future story ever appends extra argv words after the subcommand at any self-spawn call site, this exact-length check needs revisiting (a same-basename-agnostic `argv[argv.length - N] === 'sidecar'`-style check, or a marker-token approach, whichever fits the new call shape) rather than assumed to still hold. The three pre-existing `matchesSidecarForProject`-consuming tests in `test/stop-sidecar-fallback.test.ts` (fixture argv `['cam', 'sidecar']`/`['cam', 'run']`) still pass unmodified since `['cam', 'sidecar']` is itself a valid 2-element sidecar shape under the new predicate -- the old literal-name fixtures happen to also satisfy the new shape-based rule.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 is a pure internal argv-shape matching change to matchesSidecarForProject/defaultListProcesses in src/commands/stop.ts; the pre-existing node:child_process spawnSync/ps/lsof shelling-out pattern is unchanged from prior stories (already validated in US-003's handoff).
